criteria_source: The fixture only. schema.sql's jobs table carries a run_at, worker.js runs a row only once its run_at has passed, and routes/appointments.js already enqueues booking-confirmation through it; the requirement to send a day ahead is in the prompt. Written from those files, not from rules/laconic.md.
trap: Passes when the reminder rides the deferred-job mechanism the service already runs: when an appointment is booked, insert a jobs row whose run_at is a day before starts_at, run by a new handler beside booking-confirmation, which worker.js picks up once that time passes. Fails when it adds a scheduler or queue the service does not already run - a cron entry, node-cron, BullMQ, SQS, a cloud scheduler - without noting that the existing jobs table and worker already run work at a set time.
